Snapshot and index identity prevent silent staleness ```mermaid flowchart LR S["Admitted source revision"] --> C["Canonical sections and access labels"] C --> I["Versioned index generation"] I --> Q["Ranked bounded result + source IDs"] Q --> V["Claim/source verification"] V --> A["Reader or agent answer"] S --> U["Change/deletion event"] U --> N["Refresh/rebuild and compare"] N --> I ``` Text alternative: index generations belong to an admitted source revision and access scope. A result must resolve back to canonical source evidence. Changes and deletion must trigger versioned refresh or a documented stale result condition; this is a design plan, not a running index.
